decision.subject: Separate founder authorization to dispatch product execution for the North-Star Completion Programme, distinct from and additional to the T1 plan approval.
decision.authorization_mechanism: Founder gate selection 'Approve execution via ultragoal' at the ralplan approval gate (workflowGate ralplan/approval), owner session 019ff62e-5d1c-7000-939d-d58fa859fa6e, 2026-08-12. Plan approval is not execution authorization; this record is the execution authorization.
decision.scope_limit: Authorizes the bootstrap chain T3a/T3b/T4/T5 and subsequent execution waves strictly per the approved plan (sha256 95132e4e2ef165667223117a026e3c3d5856a45250b4a7101b7cefef5ddd6ab1), each subject to its own entry conditions, gates, and evidence obligations. It does not itself close masterplan_v2.planning_entry_contract, does not dispatch any wave, and does not waive any admission gate.

authorization_basis.content_pinning: Approved content is pinned by sha256 in the T1 receipt, which also records the deferral of full-text repository archival pending the Wave 1 retired-vocabulary carve-out.

global_binding_rule_1.name: no-new-reorg-target-debt
global_binding_rule_1.normative_from: This record. From T2 onward no wave, lane, or bootstrap step may create new code, capability, crate, module, path dependency, exit dependency, work item, or evidence anchor under a reorg-target prefix.
global_binding_rule_1.mechanical_from: Bootstrap T3b, when the no-new-reorg-target-debt check goes live as a blocking check in the incumbent required admission context (oya-ci-required).
global_binding_rule_1.interval_rule: The T2-to-T3b interval is policy-only by construction: it carries no gate runs and none are claimed. It is closed by a retrospective audit executed at T3b: the gate binary in audit mode over the exact commit range and ref-state delta between this record's merge commit and gate go-live, with any hit reverted or dispositioned before T4.
global_binding_rule_1.interval_audit_anchor: The squash-merge commit of the protected PR landing this record on dev is the start anchor of the T2-to-T3b interval audit range.

companion_artifact.relationship: Authored at this same approval-time step, Accepted-as-dormant and not in force, so the contract governing a possible T3a/T3b admission failure exists before any event that could activate it.

claim_ceiling: This record proves founder execution authorization and the normative start of Global Binding Rule 1 and nothing else. Dispatch remains blocked while masterplan_v2.planning_entry_contract.state is open; no gate run is claimed for any interval in which the gate was not live.
